content.value_statement: Finishing a branch requires tests, git choices, and careful cleanup. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through merge, PR, keep, or discard paths.
actual_capabilities: Prompts test verification before branch completion.
Identifies a likely base branch from local git history.
Presents four explicit completion options to the user.
Guides local merge, pull request, keep, or discard workflows.
Requires typed confirmation before deleting branch work.
Defines when worktree cleanup should and should not happen.
limitations: Requires an existing git repository and branch context.
Does not choose a workflow without user input.
Depends on available project test commands and git tooling.
GitHub PR creation requires the GitHub CLI to be configured.

use_cases.title: Finish a Feature Branch
use_cases.description: A developer can verify tests, choose merge or PR, and clean up finished branch state.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: A maintainer can push a completed branch and create a structured PR with a test plan.

use_cases.title: Close Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: An engineering team can standardize how AI agents finish work after implementation tasks end.

prompt_templates.title: Finish This Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to finish my current development branch. Verify tests first, then present the completion options.

prompt_templates.title: Merge After Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: My implementation is complete. Help me verify the test result, identify the base branch, and merge locally if I choose that path.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Finish this branch by preparing a pull request. Include a concise summary and a clear test plan after checks pass.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Worktree Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my finished branch and worktree state. Guide me through merge, PR, keep, or discard without deleting anything until I confirm.

output_examples.input: Implementation is complete and the tests pass.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports completion, lists merge, PR, keep, and discard options, then waits for the user choice.

output_examples.input: I want to discard this branch.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists the branch, commits, and worktree path, then requires the exact word discard before deletion.

output_examples.input: Create a PR for this finished feature.
output_examples.output: The assistant pushes the branch, drafts a pull request summary, includes test evidence, and preserves the worktree as specified.

best_practices: Run the real project test suite before choosing any completion path.
Confirm the base branch before merge, PR creation, or deletion.
Use the typed discard confirmation for any destructive cleanup.
anti_patterns: Do not merge or open a PR when tests are still failing.
Do not delete a branch or worktree without exact user confirmation.
Do not clean up a worktree when the chosen path preserves it.

faq.question: Does this skill merge code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It presents options and waits for the user to choose the workflow.

faq.question: Can it create pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents a GitHub CLI flow for pushing a branch and creating a PR.

faq.question: What happens if tests fail?
faq.answer: The workflow stops and reports the failures. Merge and PR steps should not continue.

faq.question: Does it delete branches?
faq.answer: Only in the discard path, and only after the user types the exact confirmation word.

faq.question: Does it support git worktrees?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes cleanup guidance for workflows where worktree removal is expected.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
